overlooked_assumption: The agent assumed that a stop-loss order with a small notional (< $50) would be allowed to execute even though the position had been held for fewer sessions than the minimum-hold period required to classify an exit as a swing trade, believing the stop rule would bypass the minimum-hold check.
why_it_breaks: The test sets last_trade_session to 10 sessions but does not set last_decision_on or entry_session, so the churn engine cannot verify whether the minimum-hold period was satisfied. The agent's transcript belief that 'stop rules bypass minimum-hold checks' caused it to omit the minimum-hold state needed for the guard to correctly reject the sell as a swing trade violation. Without that state, the guard allows the stop-loss to execute, producing the compliance breach where swing-trade count exceeds the cap.

evidence.quote: Hard drawdown rules bypass minimum-hold checks. A ~$1.8 one-dollar trim falls below the $50 threshold. Stop tests assert the reason is stop.
